title: DeepRubik — photoreal Rubik's cube puzzle
excerpt: Cube Studio — a photorealistic WebGL Rubik's cube puzzle with cube sizes from 1 to 100 and plastic, metal, glass and matte materials.
content_html:
3 × 3 × 3

26 pieces · 54 stickers

Material Plastic

Render quality Auto

Lighting & luminance
Controls & shortcuts
  • Drag a face to turn that slice — works on inner slices too.
  • The moving slice glows, so you always know what you picked up.
  • Drag the background (or right-drag) to orbit, scroll to zoom.
  • RLUDFB turn a face, Shift turns it the other way.
  • Space scrambles, Enter resets.
  • Double-click the background to reset the camera.
